name: get_active_vocab
title: Get active vocabulary
description: Get the user's most actively encountered target-language words (from past capture_word + log_interaction events), ranked by frequency over a lookback window. Use to surface "frontier" words the user keeps touching when they ask "what should I learn next" or when you want context-aware suggestions.

lang.description: Language tag (en, en-us, pt-br). Matching is on the base code, so a variant finds encounters logged under any sibling. Omit it to include ALL languages - unlike the deck tools, this one is a cross-language frequency view.
